note: Co-op Bank's tariff guide: its Classic credit card costs 3,500 shillings a year, with interest of 3.5% a month on the revolved balance; the one-off joining fee isn't counted, nor the excise duty the guide applies to all fees, whose rate it doesn't state.

sources.title: Co-op Bank, Bank Tariff Guide
sources.said: Excise duty will apply to all fees, charges and ... Interest Rate 3.5% of the revolved balance per month ... Annual Fees Classic Card: Ksh.3500
